meta.question: Is there a regime- or congestion-conditional DART edge at RVN_RN beyond the item3a $1.23/MWh baseline?
meta.convention: spread = DA - RT; short PnL = +spread; 1 MW per traded hour; no clearing model / fees
meta.data: real Yes Energy datalake prices (RVN_RN own from 2026-06-04, item2 NNLS proxy before) + item2 congestion panel + datalake system load/wind/solar actuals; no mock

verdict.conditional_edge_exists: marginal at best; nothing beats the unconditional hour-of-day rule out-of-sample on EV/MWh
verdict.best_strict_ex_ante_rule: C_short_HE14-18_if_STPWAP39_1_bound_lag2 (FULL test EV 1.07 $/MWh, t 2.7, hit 63%, Sharpe 0.14/day) - but static short HE14-18 gives 1.32 on the same test window; the condition only improves hit rate/drawdown

permutation_null.note: day labels of every regime feature permuted jointly across days (hour structure and spread autocorrelation within day preserved); tests whether the largest in-sample |t| across all regime x HE cells exceeds what selection from noise gives
